summary: Count only open answerable native asks in web attention badges and the Needs me filter

replay.detail: No replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: Uses existing generated Attention fields; no schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Requests require work.done, custom asks require custom.reply, and prompts require prompt.respond with advertised string answers. Unknown or absent answer actions remain visible but do not count as waiting for an answer.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
